title: Public recruitment roles board
summary: Guests can browse open APES CIC recruitment roles by staff, volunteer, and student category from a public board, with draft and closed roles kept private.
changes: Add guest-accessible /recruitment list and detail pages that show only open roles, with staff, volunteer, and student filters.
Surface a Roles discovery link in public chrome (sidebar, footer, and landing) when the Recruitment module is enabled.
Seed Local QA demo open roles in all three categories plus draft and closed fixtures for visibility checks.
Cover public visibility, filters, detail privacy, navigation, and seeder behaviour with feature tests.
version_rationale: Patch release on the v0.34.x line: the public roles board builds on staff CRUD from 0.34.1 without changing applications or staff review yet.
validation: PHPUnit PublicRecruitmentBoardTest, RecruitmentRoleWorkflowTest, PublicLegalPagesTest, and PublicChromeNamingTest pass for board visibility and chrome.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify (or equivalent local verify) on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: Public apply and staff application review are not included; those ship in later 0.34.x patches.
Recruitment remains APES CIC only (not Shelter or Pet Care Clinic).
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to remove the public /recruitment routes, views, and chrome links from the live app.
provenance: Public recruitment roles board for issues #214, #215, #217, and #216, pull request #243.
